g.text: US-06: Composite Emission - Atomic supersession: SIGNAL_LOSS marked SUPERSEDED, COMPOSITE inserted
SIGNAL_LOSS was already emitted when entity went dark.
Now: supersede it and emit COMPOSITE in one transaction.
Atomic: both the status update and the insert
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on the INSERT ensures
Kafka replay is safe — composite row already present
superseded_by column is a nullable FK → alerts.alert_id.
transaction committed (or idempotent no-op on replay)
Two typed messages on alert-events pub/sub.
Dashboard can update the existing SIGNAL_LOSS card
to show SUPERSEDED, then display the new COMPOSITE card.
Fan-out per connection: scope filter applied before WebSocket push.
new COMPOSITE alert displayed at elevated priority
the original SIGNAL_LOSS is visible as SUPERSEDED
alongside the COMPOSITE that explains it.
